title: eludite.solution edit output
description: What a solution edit of brief 0081 did (add_project, remove_project, add_folder, rename_folder, remove_folder, add_item, remove_item, set_project_dependencies).

written.description: True when the solution file changed on disk (the host reloaded the solution).

folder.description: add_folder and rename_folder: the folder's path after the edit.

generation.description: The solution generation after the edit.

pending.description: From the UI: the edit was sent and the host's answer is still coming.
